name: COMING ESCAPE Boku to Kanojo no Shasei Mahou
original_name: COMING ESCAPE 僕と彼女の射精魔法
source:
An adventurer girl and a merchant that can use an extremely powerful magic ability (only when he ejaculates) are captive in a monster's lair.
Their only method of escape is... Eros!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ196090.html/?locale=en_US]DLSite[/url]]
